notes: Lao is matched without word boundaries, so the list is built from compounds. Deliberately dropped: ສະພາ (assembly) because it is a prefix of ສະພາບ 'condition/situation' — the exact Thai Red Cross failure mode; bare ຈຳກັດ because every Lao company name ends in ບໍລິສັດ...ຈຳກັດ (Co., Ltd.), keeping only ການຈຳກັດ and ຈຳກັດປະລິມານ; bare ຫຼຸດ because it is the ordinary word for any decline and sits inside ຫຼຸດລົງ, so only ຫຼຸດຜ່ອນ / ຕັດຫຼຸດ / ຫຼຸດພາສີ are kept; bare ສັ່ງ because ສັ່ງຊື້ means to place a commercial order, so only ສັ່ງການ / ສັ່ງຫ້າມ / ສັ່ງຢຸດ are kept; ຫຼຸດລາຄາ because it is retail discounting rather than state action; and bare ຢຸດ as too generic. ຄຳສັ່ງ and ປະກາດ were kept despite some commercial usage because they are the standard vehicles for Lao government action. Lao is the language I am least confident about here.
